## EcclesiaOS v1.0.59

### Create-section editor redesign

- Replaced the washed-out create-section hero with the shared Website Studio header.
- Split section details and the visual builder into clear, focused cards.
- Improved the full-width editor with a responsive 360px publishing sidebar.
- Added a sticky create/cancel action bar for long section layouts.
- Refined publishing and optional-media controls to match the application brand.
- Added rendering regression coverage for the new editor structure.
